mapper.sql:
FROM document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT status, next_retry_at FROM document_import_task WHERE document_id=d.id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1 ) t ON TRUE
WHERE d.knowledge_base_id=#{kbId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.filename ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND d.active_version_id IS NOT NULL
AND d.active_version_id IS NULL AND CASE WHEN t.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') OR (t.status='FAILED' AND t.next_retry_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'IMPORTING' WHEN t.status='FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'UNPUBLISHED' END = #{status}
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id,d.knowledge_base_id,d.filename,d.active_version_id,d.created_at
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id FROM document WHERE id=#{id} AND knowledge_base_id=#{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET deleted_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND knowledge_base_id=#{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,document_id,status,published_at FROM document_index_version WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT id,knowledge_base_id,filename,active_version_id FROM document WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
